title: Königsberg Cathedral
source: Retained reference coordinate,current named Cathedral organ hall/Kant museum/tomb POIs,main/part/tomb plans and four inspected exterior pictures.
identityStatus: Reviewed approximate named-site identity from current POIs,reference coordinate and pictured asymmetric westwork/northeast tomb ordering;no exact-QID building polygon claim.
axis: Native-X is the western asymmetric facade;native+X follows the continuous long ridge toward eastern choir;native+Z carries tall southern spire,native-Z the lower northern gable and northeast tomb.

identityControl.basis: Named organ hall and Kant museum at western blocks,named tomb at northeast mapped colonnade. Matches pictured cathedral ordering;exact-QID polygon identity remains unverified.

orientationControl.basis: Longest current choir long wall gives the native axis;western tower versus eastern choir and southern spire/northern tomb in pictures resolve its sign. Plans retain raw geographic scale.

reconstruction.heightBasis: Current unscaled PMTiles main outline,26 building-part controls and northeast tomb plan define horizontal fit. Tower20m,spire50.75m,nave8m,choir11m,roof turret26m and east turret14m are mapped tags,not independent surveyed dimensions. Nave/choir tags are used as eaves with estimated24m continuous ridge;west gables26/25m,octagonal drum30m and spire subdivisions are picture-led estimates. Tomb5m tag conflicts with tall pictured columns;10.4m entablature is an explicit picture-led override. Preserve uncertainty;no exact-QID footprint claim.
reconstruction.scope: Individual medium-fi Königsberg Cathedral exterior:asymmetric detailed westwork,octagonal clock drum/green concave spire,north/central gables,steep dark long roof,broader nave/narrower choir,paired pointed windows,mapped buttresses,two minor turrets and open northeast Kant tomb colonnade. Exact inscriptions/sculpture/tracery,full interiors and certified walking excluded.
